old_description: Performance Packaging of Nevada, LLC was founded in 1995 with the vision to become a single source solution of packaging products for our customers.
about:
Performance Packaging of Nevada, LLC was founded in 1995 in Las Vegas, Nevada, with the vision of becoming a single-source provider of packaging products. The company remains privately held, though the ownership structure is not publicly disclosed.

The firm produces a wide range of packaging formats, including flexible films, pouches, rollstock, folding cartons, shrink sleeves, labels, and retail bags. Its manufacturing capabilities span multiple-layer co-extrusion blown film, extrusion and solventless lamination, tandem extrusion, and adhesive lamination, with printing up to 14 colors. The company operates production facilities across North America and Asia and maintains clean-room environments for pharmaceutical and medical-device packaging. It also offers filling machinery and pre-made pouch configurations such as spouted, zippered, and valve-equipped designs.

Performance Packaging serves the pharmaceutical, medical-device, food-and-beverage, cosmetic and personal-care, and retail sectors. Customers include companies requiring pharmaceutical-grade packaging, medical-device clean-room packaging, frozen-vegetable packaging, coffee pouches with valves, and cosmetic foil laminations.

The company emphasizes its GFSI certification, its global manufacturing footprint, and its position as a single-source supplier for all packaging needs as key differentiators.

name: Performance Wire and Cable, Inc.
old_description: XLPE cable, ground wire, and insulated wire via in-house extrusion lines
about:
Performance Wire and Cable, Inc. operates from Camden, New York, where it was founded in 2002 by Steve Benjamin, who serves as owner and president. Benjamin brought 25 years of wire-industry experience to the venture, building a dedicated team that now includes 15 extrusion operators with a combined 150 years of department-level expertise.

The company manufactures insulated copper and steel wire products on in-house extrusion lines. Its portfolio spans cathodic protection cable, horizontal directional drilling (HDD) wire, tracer wire, ground wire, XLPE cable, and electric pet fence wire, among other specialty configurations.

Customers include municipalities managing water, gas, and sewer systems; large-scale infrastructure and storage facilities; corrosion protection systems; horizontal directional drilling projects; photovoltaic and solar installations; and utility and municipal infrastructure networks.

Performance Wire and Cable emphasizes domestic production—all products are made in the USA—and conformance to UL, NEMA, ASTM, and IEEE standards. It differentiates itself with no minimum order requirements, most orders shipping within one week, and engineering support for application-specific cable design and extreme-condition testing.

about:
PerformanceParts.com operates from Lenexa, Kansas, where it has served the Midwest performance aftermarket since its founding in 1976. The business traces its industry experience back to 1970 and remains family-owned and operated.

The company functions as a retail distributor of engine, performance, and powertrain components, carrying hundreds of brands such as Comp Cams, ARP, Edelbrock, Fel-Pro, and MSD. Its product range spans gaskets, seals, ignition, fuel delivery, fasteners, and transmission parts. PerformanceParts.com fulfills orders through both a printed catalog and an e-commerce site, offering free shipping on orders over $150.

Its customer base includes engine builders, speed shops, machine shops, and retail buyers across the automotive performance sector. The distributor supplies parts for applications ranging from classic Chevrolet small-blocks to modern GM LS and Ford modular engines, as well as diesel platforms like the Cummins 5.9L and 6.7L.

PerformanceParts.com was relaunched in 2002 with a stated mission to provide a better source for performance components, summarized by the slogan "Good people offering good pricing and good service on great products." The company emphasizes knowledgeable staff and direct relationships with both professional builders and enthusiast customers.

name: Period Millworks The Woodwright Shop
old_description: At The Woodwright Shop, we pride ourselves on superior craftsmanship, attention to detail and on becoming part of your team to help create amazing millwork for all projects. Each project is highly customized and unique and everything we create is meticulously designed and crafted to ensure quality and durability.  Although we specialize in historic reproductions we also love designing for new builds as well!
about:
The Woodwright Shop operates from Covington, Louisiana, where husband-and-wife team Tom and Leah Edmonds have led the business for over two decades. The Edmonds built the shop around a shared dedication to architectural millwork, growing a team of designers and craftsmen that now includes ten members.

The shop produces historic reproduction and custom architectural millwork for both restoration projects and new construction. Its capabilities include hand-turned newel posts, balusters, and columns up to 14 feet long, custom handrail fittings such as tangent curves, and exact moulding replication from customer-supplied samples. All turnings are done by hand, and the team works from photographs or original designs to create one-off pieces.

Clients range from public institutions to hospitality and residential owners. The portfolio lists work at the Louisiana Governor's Mansion, the Historic Cabildo, Le Petit Théâtre, the Left Pontalba, Hotel Peter & Paul, the French Market Inn, the Frenchmen Hotel, and numerous other historic properties across New Orleans.

The Edmonds emphasize constant communication throughout each project and a willingness to become an extension of the client's team. They position the shop as a partner that can translate a photo or a fragment of original moulding into a finished component, with a focus on durability and detail.

name: PharoPLAST Injection Molding
old_description: PharoPlast delivers engineering-led injection molding for companies that can’t afford rework.
about:
PharoPLAST Injection Molding operates from Cleveland, Ohio, where it was founded in 1972 as Innovations in Plastic with a single injection molding machine in a small rented space. The company transitioned to its current name in 2022 when Christopher Miedza, a longtime tooling and design partner, assumed ownership. Today it remains a family-owned business led by Christopher and his son Simon Miedza, who directs sales and regional growth across the Midwest.

The shop provides engineering-led thermoplastic injection molding backed by in-house product design, DFM/DFA guidance, tooling sourcing, refurbishment, and transfer services. It also offers reshoring support, additive prototyping, and secondary operations such as assembly, welding, decoration, and packaging. PharoPLAST emphasizes flexible volume production with no minimum order quantity and advertises 24-hour lead times once tooling is on site. The facility serves both low-volume runs and large-quantity programs, though specific press counts and square footage are not disclosed.

Primary customers are OEMs and manufacturers in industrial, electrical, and equipment markets. Long-standing accounts include Parker Hannifin, Eaton, and Steris. The company focuses on the Midwest corridor — Ohio, Pennsylvania, Michigan, Kentucky, West Virginia — and works with businesses of all sizes, maintaining a dedicated small-project division for runs as low as 50 parts.

PharoPLAST was built on the premise that most molding problems originate before a part reaches the press. By integrating engineering early — catching warpage, sink, and assembly conflicts before steel is cut — the company aims to eliminate rework, compress launch timelines, and give customers transparent tooling ownership and direct access to decision-makers.

name: Phelps Industrial Products
old_description: Phelps is a major manufacturer, fabricator and distributor of Industrial Gaskets, Compression Packing and Sealing Devices
about:
Phelps Industrial Products was established in 1945 in Laurel, Maryland, to supply fluid sealing products worldwide. The company operates as a manufacturer, fabricator, and distributor of industrial gaskets, compression packing, and sealing devices.

The company produces a range of sealing solutions including gaskets, compression packing, spiral wound gaskets, O-rings, molded parts, mechanical seals, marine products, adhesives, sealants, Topog-E boiler gaskets, and cutting tools. Its fabrication capabilities encompass die-cutting, laser-cutting, waterjet-cutting, and hand-cutting to meet custom requirements. Phelps serves a global customer base across North America, South America, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Australia.

Key industries served include power generation, petrochemicals, pumps and valves, marine, water treatment, oil and gas, pharmaceutical, construction, commercial HVAC, and defense. Customers such as Assa Abloy/Megadoor have relied on Phelps for elastomers and packing, while testimonials highlight long-term relationships in pump packing and custom seal fabrication.

Founded on the goal of delivering high-performing fluid sealing products at competitive prices, Phelps emphasizes decades of custom fabrication experience and technical expertise to solve unique applications.

name: Phoenix Design Concepts Inc
old_description: Founded in 2010, Phoenix Design Concepts Inc. is an expansion of a previously existing company with a focus on performance wear production for more than 20 years. Founded and owned by
about:
Phoenix Design Concepts Inc. operates from Indianapolis, Indiana, where it was founded in 2010 as an expansion of a predecessor company that had specialized in performance wear for over two decades. The business is owned by Diana Baisa, who brought more than 40 years of fashion-industry experience, including training at a European master tailoring school, and earlier ran the custom dress and suit operation Coffield & Co. serving show choirs nationwide.

The company provides cut-and-sew manufacturing for custom garments, including show choir dresses, suits, performance wear, and face masks. Its OSHA-compliant facility houses over 58 commercial manual and computerized sewing machines, multiple vacuum-powered cutting tables, and modern design and production software, all maintained by an in-house mechanic. Production is organized in three volume tiers: 10–50 pieces per style for small runs, 51–1,000 pieces for mid-level factory runs, and 1,001–5,000 pieces for larger factory runs.

Customers include schools and show choir programs that have used the Coffield Collection brand, as well as brands and businesses nationwide seeking custom sewn goods. The company also partners with local schools to provide paid entry-level positions for students interested in the fashion and cut-and-sew industry.

Phoenix Design Concepts emphasizes domestic production—all design, cutting, and sewing are performed in central Indiana—and a workforce development mission that includes training sewing engineers through a two-week onboarding program. The company cites competitive pricing, rigorous quality control at each assembly step, and a 24-hour customer service response commitment as key differentiators.

name: Phoenix Hardwood & Plywood
old_description: Our company has set a new standard in the hardwood lumber industry.
about:
Phoenix Hardwood & Plywood operates from Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, and has been supplying hardwood products since 2000. The company functions as a wholesale distributor serving the state of Oklahoma from its facility on North Classen Boulevard.

The firm distributes hardwood lumber, hardwood plywood, and architectural mouldings sourced globally, alongside industrial panels such as particle board, MDF, and thermally fused melamine. It maintains a full inventory of both domestic and import plywood with a wide variety of veneers. It also supplies cabinet hardware — including hinges, drawer guides, and kitchen accessories — from brands like Salice, Fulterer USA, and X-Series Bracket. Customers can request custom quotes for all products, and the company runs a delivery schedule across Oklahoma.

Its customer base spans the residential and commercial cabinet industry, lumber yards, store fixture manufacturers, and custom furniture makers throughout the region.

Phoenix Hardwood & Plywood says it set a new standard in the hardwood lumber industry by providing superior quality products from around the world, offering the latest advancements in product technology and environmentally friendly building materials, and delivering a level of service described as unlike any other in the market.

name: Phoenix Woodworking Corporation
old_description: As an AWI QCP Certified architectural millwork company, Phoenix Woodworking provides the highest standard of quality casework for commercial customers throughout the United States.
about:
Phoenix Woodworking Corporation operates from Woodstock, Illinois, a northwest Chicago suburb. It is certified as a woman-owned business and operates as a locally owned and operated firm.

The shop specializes in architectural millwork and custom casework for commercial interiors, producing cabinetry, fixtures, and furniture-grade pieces. Its work blends traditional joinery and finishing techniques with modernized processes, serving projects across the United States. No facility size or headcount figures are publicly disclosed.

Phoenix Woodworking serves design houses, interior decorators, general contractors, and commercial developers. Its portfolio includes restaurants, salons, civic buildings such as the Woodridge Police Department and Wheeling Fire Station, offices, and school projects. Clients range from independent designers to construction firms like TOR Construction and RB Construction.

The company highlights its AWI QCP certification, a core-values framework emphasizing craftsmanship, integrity, connection, empowerment, and innovation, and a heritage-meets-modern ethos as differentiators. Leadership frames the business as a partnership-driven operation that values honest communication and reliable delivery on schedule and spec.
